newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Pacific Hydro to raise A$20 mln in issue.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Hydro to raise A$20 mln in issue.

text.p: Electricity power group Pacific Hydro Ltd said on Wednesday that it planned to issue 20 million shares at A$1.00 each to fund further development and acquisitions in Australia and overseas.
Pacific Hydro said the placement would be made to 12 institutional investors which have agreed to subscribe for the shares, subject to shareholder approval at a meeting to be convened early in May.
It said the placement has been substantially over subscribed. Pacific Hydro shares last traded on Tuesday when it closed steady at A$1.01. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
